private_prototype.failure_behavior: Terminal; no automatic retry or register restoration
private_prototype.output: Private exclusive .partial file; binary-envelope checks required, IP tables still need offline validation

implementation: Private independently written userspace wrapper using the existing nullarc transport; source and fixtures retained locally. No Linux bodies or whole headers copied into the prototype. This is not a shipped driver feature or a hardware result.
